summary_of_bug: PosixParser/CommandLine does not correctly expose an option value by the option’s long name when the option is created with both a short name ('d') and long name ("debug"). In the reported case, parsing "-d true" should allow getOptionValue("debug") and hasOption("debug") to behave the same as getOptionValue('d')/hasOption('d'), but the long-name lookup returns null or is otherwise not recognized.
